check: exp_gen_store._assert_cache_reencodes, the SHIPPED gate, run against both generations with the encoder stored beside each cache
note: The gate re-encodes cache_rows[:64] - deterministic, no sampling - and compares against the cached values at the cache dtype. It is the gate exp_gen_cell calls at the top of every run_seed.

verdict.statement: Generation 1 is not reproduced by the encoder shipped beside it on this box, on any seed, by 51-81 ULP on 0.49-0.98% of elements - the documented CPU-vs-GPU signature (~53 ULP on ~1% of elements). Generation 2 sits at 1-3 ULP on 1e-5 of elements, the floor batch-shape reordering allows. This does NOT invalidate any published generation-1 number: those numbers were computed on those features. It says generation 1 cannot be reproduced, extended or audited here.
